    }
  } catch {}

  });

  };
}

var BC = 10;
function Oh(A, Q, B, Y = {}) {
  let J = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(A.length / BC));
  let C = Math.max(0, Math.min(B, J - 1));
  let F = C * BC;
  let U = A.slice(F, F + BC);
  let Z = U.map((W, G) => {
    let D = F + G + 1;
    let z = W.id === Q;
    let H = _(Yj(W.firstPrompt, 200) || "без описания");
    let j = ky(W, 120);
    let I = j ? `
   ↳ остановились на: «${_(j)}»` : "";
    let q = m2Q(W.lastActivity);
    let $ = W.project ? `[${_(W.project)}]` : "[workspace]";
    let N = Y.journalIds?.has(W.id) ? " · ⟲ контекст восстановится из журнала" : "";
    return `${D}. ${H}${z ? " ← текущая" : ""}${I}
   ${$} · ${q} · ${W.messageCount} сообщ.${N}`;
  });
  let E = J > 1 ? ` — стр. ${C + 1}` : "";
  let X = `\uD83D\uDCCB <b>Сессии</b> (${A.length})${E}:

${Z.slice().reverse().join(`

`)}`;
  let V = [];
  for (let W = 0; W < U.length; W += 5) {
    V.push(U.slice(W, W + 5).map((G, D) => ({
      text: `${F + W + D + 1}${G.id === Q ? " ✓" : ""}`,
      callback_data: `session:${G.id}`
    })));
  }
  if (J > 1) {
    let W = [];
    if (C > 0) {
      let G = (C - 1) * BC + 1;
      let D = C * BC;
      W.push({
        text: `« ${G}-${D}`,
        callback_data: `sessions:page:${C - 1}`
      });
    }
    if (C < J - 1) {
      let G = (C + 1) * BC + 1;
      let D = Math.min((C + 2) * BC, A.length);
      W.push({
        text: `${G}-${D} »`,
        callback_data: `sessions:page:${C + 1}`
      });
    }
    if (W.length > 0) {
      V.push(W);
    }
  }
  if (Y.showRestorePrev) {
    V.push([{
      text: "⟲ Вернуть предыдущую",
      callback_data: "sessions:restoreprev"
    }]);
  }
  V.push([{
    text: "« Назад",
    callback_data: "menu:back"
  }]);
  return {
    text: X,
    buttons: V
  };
}

var qh = 9;
function _h(A, Q, B, Y) {
  let J = Math.ceil(A.length / qh);
  let C = Math.max(0, Math.min(B, J - 1));
  let F = A.slice(C * qh, (C + 1) * qh);
  let U = A.map(G => {
    if (G === Q) {
      return `▸ ${G} — текущий`;
    }
    return `  ${G}`;
  });
  let E = [!Q ? "▸ ~/workspace — текущий" : "  ~/workspace", ...U].join(`
`);
  let X = `\uD83D\uDCC1 <b>Проекты</b> (${A.length}):

<code>${E}</code>

Переключить: /project <i>название</i>`;
  let V = [];
  let W = Q ? "📂 ~/workspace" : "📂 ~/workspace ✓";
  V.push([{
    text: W,
    callback_data: "project:__default__"
  }]);
  for (let G = 0; G < F.length; G += 3) {
    V.push(F.slice(G, G + 3).map(D => ({
      text: `${D === Q ? "✓ " : ""}${D}`,
      callback_data: `project:${D}`
    })));
  }
  if (J > 1) {
    let G = [];
    if (C > 0) {
      G.push({
        text: "◀️",
        callback_data: `projects:page:${C - 1}`
      });
    }
    G.push({
      text: `${C + 1}/${J}`,
      callback_data: "noop"
    });
    if (C < J - 1) {
      G.push({
        text: "▶️",
        callback_data: `projects:page:${C + 1}`
      });
    }
    V.push(G);
  }
  V.push([{
    text: "➕ Новый проект",
    callback_data: "menu:newproject"
  }]);
  if (Y) {
    V.push([{
      text: "« Назад",
      callback_data: "menu:back"
    }]);
  } else {
    V.push([{
      text: "✖ Закрыть",
      callback_data: "menu:close"
    }]);
  }
  return {
    text: X,
    keyboard: {
      inline_keyboard: V
    }
  };
}

R.command("project", async A => {
  let Q = A.match?.trim();
  if (!Q) {
    let E = (await m())?.activeProject;
    let X = _A();
    await A.reply(E ? `\uD83D\uDCCD Активный проект: <code>${_(E)}</code>

Переключить: /project <i>название</i>`, {
      parse_mode: "HTML"
    });
    return;
  }
  let B = await import("node:fs/promises");
  let Y = SA.dirname(qA());
  let J = SA.join(Y, "projects");
  if (Q.startsWith("new ")) {
    let Z = Q.slice(4).trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "");
    if (!Z) {
      await A.reply("❌ Название проекта — только латиница, цифры, - и _");
      return;
    }
    let E = SA.join(J, Z);
    try {
      await B.mkdir(SA.join(E, "memory"), {
        recursive: true
      });
      await B.mkdir(SA.join(E, "knowledge"), {

      });
      let {
        exec: X
      } = await import("node:child_process");
      X(`git init "${E}"`, () => {});
      N1(E);
      let V = await m();
      if (V) {
        V.activeProject = Z;
        V.ccSessionId = undefined;
        if (V.engine === "oc") {
          pQ(V, "project new");
        }
        await e(V);
      }
      await A.reply(nq(_(Z), {
        dirHtml: _(E),
        adapter: V?.engine === "oc"
      }), {
        parse_mode: "HTML"
      });
    } catch (X) {
      await A.reply(`❌ Ошибка: ${_(X.message.slice(0, 200))}`);
    }
    return;
  }
  let C = Q.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "");
  if (C === "home" || C === "default") {
    H4();
    let Z = await m();
    if (Z) {
      Z.activeProject = undefined;
      Z.ccSessionId = undefined;
      if (Z.engine === "oc") {
        pQ(Z, "/project home");
      }
      await e(Z);
    }
    await A.reply("📍 Переключился на <code>~/workspace</code>", {
      parse_mode: "HTML"
    });
    return;
  }
  let F = SA.join(J, C);
  try {
    await B.access(F);
  } catch {
    await A.reply(`❌ Проект <code>${_(C)}</code> не найден.

Создать: /project new ${_(C)}`, {
      parse_mode: "HTML"
    });
    return;
  }
  N1(F);
  let U = await m();
  if (U) {
    U.activeProject = C;
    U.ccSessionId = undefined;
    if (U.engine === "oc") {
      pQ(U, "/project switch");
    }
    await e(U);
  }
  await A.reply(`\uD83D\uDCCD Переключился на проект <code>${_(C)}</code>
\uD83D\uDCC2 <code>${_(F)}</code>`, {
    parse_mode: "HTML"
  });
});
var JC = new Map();
function Lh(A) {
  let Q = Date.now() - new Date(A).getTime();
  let B = Math.floor(Q / 3600000);
  let Y = Math.floor(Q % 3600000 / 60000);
  let J = new Date(A);
  let C = J.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    timeZone: "UTC"
  });
  let F = J.toLocaleTimeString("ru-RU", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "UTC"
  });
  let U = B > 0 ? `~${B}ч ${Y}м назад` : `~${Y}м назад`;
  return `${C}, ${F} UTC (${U})`;
}
async function b4(A, Q, B) {
  try {
    let Y = SA.join(IW.homedir(), ".msb");
    await PQ.mkdir(Y, {
      recursive: true
    });
    let J = {
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      kind: "tunnel_connect",
      stage: A,
      reason: B ?? null,
      tunnelName: Q
    };
    await PQ.appendFile(SA.join(Y, "errors.jsonl"), `${JSON.stringify(J)}
`);
  } catch {}
  try {
    let Y = process.env.SYNC_URL || process.env.MSB_SYNC_URL;
    let J = process.env.SYNC_KEY || process.env.MSB_SYNC_KEY;
    if (!Y || !J) {
      return;
    }
    await fetch(`${Y}/api/report/tunnel`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${J}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        stage: A,
        reason: B ?? null,
        tunnel_name: Q,
        bot_id: process.env.MSB_BOT_ID || undefined
      }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000)
    });
  } catch {}
}
async function h$(A, Q) {

async function JB(A, Q, B) {
  let Y = Q ? UY(Q).slice(0, 512) : null;
  try {
    let J = SA.join(IW.homedir(), ".msb");
    await PQ.mkdir(J, {
      recursive: true
    });
    let C = {
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      kind: "agent_error",
      error_kind: A,
      detail: Y,
      engine: B?.engine ?? null,
      model: B?.model ?? null,
      session_id: B?.sessionId ?? null
    };
    await PQ.appendFile(SA.join(J, "errors.jsonl"), `${JSON.stringify(C)}
`);
  } catch {}
  try {
    let J = process.env.SYNC_URL || process.env.MSB_SYNC_URL;
    let C = process.env.SYNC_KEY || process.env.MSB_SYNC_KEY;
    if (!J || !C) {
      return;
    }
    await fetch(`${J}/api/report/agent-error`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${C}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        kind: A,
        detail: KC(Y),
        engine: B?.engine ?? undefined,
        model: B?.model ?? undefined,
        session_id: B?.sessionId ?? undefined,
        bot_id: process.env.MSB_BOT_ID || undefined
      }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000)
    });
  } catch {}
}

function xGA(A, Q) {
  let B = $m(A) ?? bW(Q) ?? undefined;
  if (!B || B === "unknown") {

function n2Q(A, Q) {
  let B = A.toLowerCase();
  if (A.startsWith("MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE:")) {
    return "message_too_large";
  }
  if (B.includes("контекст переполнен") || B.includes("context window") || B.includes("conversation too long") || B.includes("prompt is too long")) {
    return "context_overflow";
  }
  if (B.includes("лимит подписки") || B.includes("лимит провайдера") || B.includes("rate") && B.includes("limit")) {
    return "rate_limit";
  }
  if (B.includes("не авторизован") || B.includes("unauthorized") || B.includes("invalid_api_key") || B.includes("подключи ключ") || B.includes("ошибка авторизации подписки") || B.includes("authentication_failed") || B.includes("authentication error") || B.includes("oauth_org_not_allowed") || B.includes("organization has disabled") || B.includes("organization has been disabled") || B.includes("invalid x-api-key") || B.includes("oauth token has expired") || B.includes("\"type\":\"error\"") && B.includes("401") || /\b401\b/.test(B) && (B.includes("api") || B.includes("auth") || B.includes("anthropic"))) {
    return "provider_auth";
  }
  if (B.includes("read-only file system") || B.includes("erofs") || B.includes("nonewprivileges")) {
    return "sandbox_readonly_fs";
  }
  if (t0A(A)) {
    return "oc_device_approval_pending";
  }
  return "turn_failed";
}

R.command("recovery", async A => {
  try {
    let Q = await import("node:fs/promises");
    let {
      InputFile: B
    } = await import("grammy");
    let Y = SA.join(process.env.HOME || "/home/client", ".msb");
    let J = SA.join(Y, "recovery-access.txt");
    try {
      await Q.access(J);
    } catch {
      J = SA.join(Y, "backup-key.txt");
    }
    let C = await Q.readFile(J, "utf-8");
    if (!C.trim()) {
      await A.reply("⚠️ Файл аварийного доступа пуст. Обратись в поддержку.");
      return;
    }
    let F = new B(Buffer.from(C, "utf-8"), "recovery-access.txt");
    await A.replyWithDocument(F, {
      caption: ["🛟 <b>Аварийный доступ к серверу</b>", "", "Этот файл содержит пароль для входа через DigitalOcean Recovery Console.", "", "Когда нужен: если бот, VS Code и SSH не работают одновременно.", "Как использовать: cloud.digitalocean.com → Droplets → твой сервер → Access → Recovery Console", "Логин и пароль — в файле выше (копируй значение после =)", "", "Сохрани этот файл в надёжном месте."].join(`
`),
      parse_mode: "HTML"
    });
  } catch (Q) {
    let B = Q.message;
    if (B.includes("ENOENT")) {
      await A.reply("⚠️ Файл аварийного доступа не найден. Обратись в поддержку.");
    } else {
      await A.reply(`❌ Ошибка: ${B.slice(0, 100)}`);
    }
  }
});

      });

      }
    } catch (U) {
      await R.api.editMessageText(A.chat.id, C.message_id, `Не получилось сжать: ${U.message.slice(0, 200)}`).catch(() => {});
    } finally {
      clearInterval(F);
    }
    return;

    await A.reply("Нет активной CC-сессии. Напиши что-нибудь сначала.");

  let B = await m();

  let F = C.filter(j => j.type === "system").length;
  let U = C.length - F;
  let Z = B?.authMode === "subscription" ? "Подписка Claude" : B?.authMode === "api-key" ? "API ключ" : "Не настроен";

  let V = B?.costHistory?.[X] ?? 0;

  D.push(`\uD83D\uDD0C ${Z}`);
  D.push(`\uD83E\uDDE0 ${E}`);
  D.push(`\uD83D\uDD50 ${B?.timezone || "не задан"}`);
  D.push("");
  D.push(`\uD83E\uDDE9 Навыки: ${C.length} (${F} системных + ${U} своих)`);
  D.push(`\uD83D\uDCB0 Сегодня: $${V.toFixed(2)} / ${G}`);
  if (B?.costHistory) {

    if (j.length > 0) {
      D.push(j.map(I => `  ${I}: $${(B.costHistory[I] ?? 0).toFixed(2)}`).join(`

    }
  }
  let {
    CLIENT_VERSION: z
  } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => {
    kC();
    return vL;
  });
  D.push(`\uD83E\uDD16 ${z}`);
  try {
    let {
      exec: j
    } = await import("node:child_process");
    let I = L => new Promise(M => {
      j(L, {
        timeout: 5000
      }, (g, w) => M(w?.trim() || "?"));
    });
    let [q, $, N] = await Promise.all([I(`df -h / | tail -1 | awk '{print $3"/"$2" ("$5")"}'`), I(`free -h | awk '/^Mem:/{print $3"/"$2}'`), I(`awk '{d=int($1/86400);h=int(($1%86400)/3600);m=int(($1%3600)/60);if(d>0)printf"%dд %dч",d,h;else if(h>0)printf"%dч %dмин",h,m;else printf"%dмин",m}' /proc/uptime`)]);
    D.push("");

    D.push(`\uD83E\uDDEE RAM: ${$}`);
    D.push(`⏱ Uptime: ${N}`);
  } catch {}
  let H = new JA().text("« Назад", "menu:back");

    try {
      await A.api.editMessageText(A.chat.id, Q, D.join(`

      });

    });

R.command("undo", async A => {
  let Q = BK();
  if (!Q) {
    await A.reply("Нечего отменять. Undo хранит только последнюю файловую операцию.");
    return;
  }
  let B = Math.floor((Date.now() - Q.timestamp) / 1000);
  if (B > 3600) {
    dJ();
    await A.reply(`❌ Undo истёк (${Math.floor(B / 60)} мин назад). Безопаснее откатить вручную.`);
    return;
  }
  let Y = await import("node:fs/promises");
  try {
    if (Q.previousContent === null) {
      await Y.unlink(Q.filePath);
      dJ();
      await A.reply(`↩️ Удалён файл (был создан):
<code>${_(Q.filePath)}</code>`, {
        parse_mode: "HTML"
      });
    } else {
      await Y.writeFile(Q.filePath, Q.previousContent);
      dJ();
      await A.reply(`↩️ Восстановлен файл:
<code>${_(Q.filePath)}</code>`, {
        parse_mode: "HTML"
      });
    }
  } catch (J) {
    await A.reply(`❌ Ошибка undo: ${_(J.message.slice(0, 200))}`);
  }
});

});

        await A.api.editMessageText(A.chat.id, H.message_id, `✔ <b>${_(j.name)}</b> добавлен. ${N > 0 ? `${N} видео в ленте.` : "Видео пока нет."} Дайджест в ${await L}:00.`, {
          parse_mode: "HTML"
        });
      } catch {
        await A.api.editMessageText(A.chat.id, H.message_id, `✔ YouTube канал <code>${_(j.name)}</code> добавлен.`, {
          parse_mode: "HTML"
        });
      }
    } else {
      await A.api.editMessageText(A.chat.id, H.message_id, "Канал уже в списке.");
    }
    return;
  }
  if (W.startsWith("add tw ")) {
    let z = W.slice(7).trim();
    if (!z) {
      await A.reply("Формат: /sources add tw @handle");
      return;
    }
    if (!process.env.X_BEARER_TOKEN) {
      await A.reply(`❌ Для Twitter нужен <code>X_BEARER_TOKEN</code>.
Добавь через /settings → Переменные окружения.`, {
        parse_mode: "HTML"
      });
      return;
    }
    if ((await J(z)).added) {
      let j = await A.reply("🔍 Добавляю...");
      try {
        let {
          pollTwitter: I
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => {
          nH();
          return dO;
        });
        let $ = (await I()).newItems;
        if ($ > 0) {
          Promise.resolve().then(() => {
            lJ();
            return pJ;
          }).then(N => N.syncAndProcess({
            source: "twitter"
          })).catch(() => {});
        }
        await A.api.editMessageText(A.chat.id, j.message_id, `✔ Twitter <b>@${_(z.replace(/^@/, ""))}</b> добавлен. ${$ > 0 ? `Загружено ${$} твитов.` : "Твитов пока нет."}`, {
          parse_mode: "HTML"
        });
      } catch {
        await A.api.editMessageText(A.chat.id, j.message_id, `✔ Twitter @${_(z.replace(/^@/, ""))} добавлен.`, {
          parse_mode: "HTML"
        });
      }
    } else {
      await A.reply("Аккаунт уже в списке.");
    }
    return;
  }
  if (W.startsWith("remove yt ")) {
    let z = W.slice(10).trim();
    let H = await Y(z);
    await A.reply(H ? "✔ Канал удалён." : "Канал не найден.");
    return;
  }
  if (W.startsWith("remove tw ")) {
    let z = W.slice(10).trim();
    let H = await C(z);
    await A.reply(H ? "✔ Аккаунт удалён." : "Аккаунт не найден.");
    return;
  }
  if (W.startsWith("add gh ")) {
    let H = W.slice(7).trim().match(/(?:github\.com\/)?([^/\s]+)\/([^/\s]+)/);
    if (!H) {
      await A.reply("Формат: <code>/sources add gh owner/repo</code>", {
        parse_mode: "HTML"
      });
      return;
    }
    let j = H[1];
    let I = H[2].replace(/\.git$/, "");
    if ((await F(j, I)).added) {
      let $ = await A.reply("🔍 Добавляю...");
      try {
        let {
          pollGitHub: N
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => {
          aH();
          return nO;
        });
        let {
          loadState: L
        } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => {
          GA();
          return F0;
        });
